items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: He played all the Joe Van Nudie stuff.

ctx.x: There were quite a few of you fiddlers around in the early years. Now you went to banjo, what happened to the rest of them? They tried to make it to the middle of the fiddle.

Wyatt Houston was one of them that was a classical fiddler that turned to jazz and he really could play it. He played all the Joe Van Nudie stuff. Is that so? And all the Eddie Saw's stuff. I tell you what we did, we had a job. The booking agent asked me, he says, can you get a little string band together? There's no piano in the roadhouse. We're out at 111th Street. I said, yes, I'll get you. So I got Milton Hinton. You know he's big in New York now. I got Milton Hinton. He was in school, still in school. He'd…
I remember when I go like when you had the trill.
